title: Soft Hands (The Patient Game Wins)
style: country pop ballad, 86 BPM, soft acoustic guitar, fingerpicked, tender female lead, warm male duet, brushed snare, slide guitar accents, paddle-tap percussion, mandolin solo, patient sport-anthem vibe, sing-along chorus, hooky earworm, radio-ready, crossover pop
lyrics:
[Intro — soft acoustic guitar, single paddle tap on the beat]
[paddle tap]…[paddle tap]…[paddle tap]…
Soft. Soft. Soft.
The patient game starts here.

[Verse 1 — female lead, country-pop tender]
Everybody wants to drive it, everybody wants to crush
The ball that pops at ninety, that adrenaline rush
But the player who wins the long point, the player who lasts
Knows the line is where you slow it down at last

[Pre-Chorus — soft harmony]
Drop it low, drop it soft, drop it slow
Make 'em pop one up, that's how the drivers go
Patient like a Sunday, gentle like a kiss
Soft hands every time, they pop one up, never miss

[Chorus — singable, country-pop hook]
Soft hands, slow heart
Patient at the line from the start
The driver wants to win in three
The patient ones win for ETERNITY
Soft hands, baby, soft hands!

[Verse 2 — male lead, smooth]
Saw a player at the senior center court
Eighty years young, paddle soft, never running out of breath short
She drew the rally out, fifty shots at the line
He drove it into the net — the soft game wins every time

[Pre-Chorus]
Drop it low, drop it soft, drop it slow
Make 'em pop one up, that's how the drivers go
Patient like a Sunday, gentle like a kiss
Soft hands every time, they pop one up, never miss

[Chorus]
Soft hands, slow heart
Patient at the line from the start
The driver wants to win in three
The patient ones win for ETERNITY
Soft hands, baby, soft hands!

[Bridge — slow]
The soft game is the whole game
The drivers don't know yet
They learn in five years, ten years
After their elbows are wet
The patient plays till ninety
The driver taps out at fifty
Patience pays the longer interest, honey

[Verse 3 — duet]
[female] Cross-court drop
[male] Down the line
[female] Reset the point
[male] Take your time
[both] Patient hands and a quiet wrist
[both] Soft as a feather, never miss

[Final Chorus — full band]
Soft hands, slow heart
Patient at the line from the start
The driver wants to win in three
The patient ones win for ETERNITY
Soft hands, baby, SOFT HANDS!

[Outro — whispered]
[paddle tap]
[paddle tap]
[paddle tap]
…win the next ball.
